additional_info.subject: Case Opening Remark
additional_info.body:
Borusan EnBW, one of the CPOs in Turkey, has started working with Monta. However, they are encountering numerous issues, one of which is outlet status…
Borusan reported that outlet statuses are continuously switching between "unavailable" and "available." When I checked one of the devices, I found the logs shown in the attached image. And also I shared the log files at the attachment.
They are encountering all devices. Why the outlets continuously switching between "unavailable" and "available."?

additional_info.subject: ID0411291-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R6 170002150] Outlet status change CRM:00251000504
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Reetesh

Product

Main Asset

ChargerID/Serial No.

Problem Description
: Technical query on Outlet Status Change
Upon investigating the logs of 7th March between 08:50 to 09:30 UTC, here is my finding:
The outlet status was toggling between status “Available” & “Preparing” & “Available” as user was trying to start the session, but it failed because of delay in Authorization and power saving mode.
Then there was a remote reboot, which set the outlet status to “Unavailable”, before setting it back to “Available”
(refer Attached logs).
2025-03-07T09:07:00.140094+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/ad606c64e791[740]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (d8113f41-aaf0-452d-8c1b-c1c1f00c5bf5) - {"type":"Hard"}
I don't see any OCPP bug or abnormality in the charging logs
For future reference, your case number is
0411291
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.  As your query is answered, shall I close the case now.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
